item.title: Takeda Gene Therapy Phase 2/3 Win
item.description:
• Summary: Takeda's gene therapy program achieves positive Phase 2/3 results, providing a second life for the therapy. The win also highlights UK cancer biotechs' funding.
  • MoAs: Gene therapy - delivery of a functional gene to correct genetic defects.
  • Sources: Endpoints News

item.title: IPF Fibrosis Investor Interest
item.description:
• Summary: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) is attracting increased investor interest as multiple biotechs develop novel therapies aimed at halting fibrosis progression while improving tolerability. Current treatments have limited efficacy and side effects, creating a need for better options.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: BioSpace
